hooks.name: Block writes to secrets and generated files

action.command: python3 -c "import json,sys,re;d=json.load(sys.stdin);s=json.dumps(d);sys.exit(2) if re.search(r'(\\.config/phantomops/|/\\.env|frontend/dist/|audit\\.log)',s) else sys.exit(0)" || { echo 'Blocked: secrets, audit log or generated files must not be edited by agents.' >&2; exit 2; }
